description: Keywords a competitor ranks for in Google but your domain does not: up to 25, highest search volume first, with the competitor's ranking page (DataForSEO Labs Domain Intersection). Returns: JSON with domain, competitor, total_available, keywords. PAID: 0.045 USDC per call (USDC on eip155:8453, x402 v2). Requires an x402-capable MCP client that attaches the payment in _meta["x402/payment"] (e.g. createx402MCPClient from @x402/mcp). Without a payment this tool returns a "payment required" result and charges nothing.

competitor.description: The competitor's domain, e.g. competitor.com: the keywords it ranks for are returned.

domain.description: Your domain, e.g. example.com: keywords it already ranks for are excluded.

language_code.description: Language code such as en or de. Default: English if available for the country, else its first language. Unsupported country/language pairs are refused before payment.

location_code.description: DataForSEO location code. Country level: 2840 = United States (default), 2276 = Germany, 2040 = Austria, 2756 = Switzerland. Google SERP, Maps, News, Images and Local Market Check also accept city/region codes in Germany, Austria and Switzerland (free lookup: GET /api/v1/locations?q=...).

name: keyword_gap
